class: Suggestion cards that cannot say what the form will ask, so the owner learns about custom questions mid-application
fix: New readiness.py: fetches the published Greenhouse form (?questions=true, all blocks), runs each required question through the real answer stack (profile fact via match_concept+resolve_profile_value, upload, or approved answer-bank hit), and summarizes honestly ('All 8 required answered' or the named gaps). Stored per job (readiness_json), computed in-scan for jobs >= 85 and on demand via the card's 'Check what it asks' (JSON swap, no reload).
prevention: Pre-application predictions reuse the application stack itself (same matcher, same bank) so the card cannot promise what the run cannot do.
root_cause: Nothing pre-read application forms: the public Greenhouse questions endpoint was unused, so cards showed scores but no question inventory, and custom required questions surfaced only when the run stopped on them.
site: readiness.py, job_discovery.py, web_ui.py, discovered_view.py, static/cockpit.js, 3 November 2026
symptom: suggested jobs gave no sense of what the application would demand; owners discovered blocking custom questions only mid-run.
why_tests_missed: No test asked what a suggested posting's form contains; discovery stopped at the description.
